findings.title: 1. Wall interpretation breaks on outlines and scans
findings.observed: Deterministic wall IoU: 22.7% on four CubiCasa plans versus 84.0% on four ResPlan renders. P01 recovers no rooms and all 41 window proposals are false positives; annotation strokes and wall outlines confuse the rules.
findings.next: Improve wall-band construction and exclusion of annotation strokes; check both drawing styles for regressions.

findings.title: 2. Openings need rules for different drawing conventions
findings.observed: Deterministic doors: 2 matched, 49 extra, 106 missed. Windows: 12 matched, 171 extra, 98 missed. P05 has good walls but misses all 10 doors; swing-only recognition is a poor fit for these rendered symbols.
findings.next: Separate gap, leaf/swing and glazing evidence. Require wall attachment and local continuity before calling parallel lines a window.

findings.title: 3. Zero stair proposals means zero recall here
findings.observed: Deterministic stairs: 0 matched, 0 extra, 8 missed. P09 contains a visible flight but no accepted stair group. Some earlier grouping rejection gates are not logged, so the exact cause is not proven.
findings.next: Instrument each rejection gate and inspect fragmented tread/rail grouping before relaxing thresholds. Review whether labeled stairs are visible in the ResPlan renders.

findings.title: 4. Two methods can agree on a shared mistake
findings.observed: This P05 room pair overlaps at 77.4% IoU, but both candidates are false positives against the supplied room labels. The labels have not been newly manually verified. Agreement is not correctness.
findings.next: Use agreement to focus inspection; keep the clean crop and evaluator results visible. Neither source should automatically veto the other.

findings.title: 5. ML also over-detects; specialist success is uneven
findings.observed: Main-model window recall is 87.3%, but precision is 44.4%. CAD gets all four P09 doors and its stair, yet on P10 doors it has 3 matches, 16 extras and 10 misses. CAD has no wall/room output.
findings.next: Keep precision and recall visible, evaluate duplicate/fragmented proposals separately, and compare the specialist on the same two plans rather than mixing it into main-model totals.
